title: FairGig AI — Multi-Agent AI System for Fair and Explainable Gig Task Allocation
model_task: Worker-task success prediction and fair task allocation
important_note: The reported overall PR-AUC is evaluated over all candidate pairs. An eligible-only evaluation should also be reported because the actual allocation decision is made among eligible workers.
allocation_formula: 0.70 * predicted_success + 0.30 * efficiency + lambda * opportunity_credit - lambda * workload_pressure
